policy: vanilla -> official REDmod -> Biology-owned narrow scripting -> generic extension only when necessary

consumerFeatures: future Biology-owned archives/tweaks/audio/whole-file script routes when appropriate
dependencies.rationale: Official package/deployment authority for the REDmod-first release. The supported 2.31 tool is game-provided and must never be redistributed by Biology.

consumerFeatures: Biology body UI/runtime and lifecycle hooks
native hook seams listed in manifest/native-seams.json
dependencies.plannedAction: retain while accepted additive/wrapper seams remain; reassess only if a demonstrably narrower official route replaces every consumer
dependencies.rationale: The merged Biology runtime relies on additive/wrapper annotations. Replacing the same narrow hooks with whole vanilla REDmod .script files would increase copied upstream implementation, conflict surface and patch fragility.

consumerFeatures: current accessible UI/persistence adapter for Enable Biology
current accessible UI/persistence adapter for E3-inspired HUD + nameplates
dependencies.plannedAction: remove after Lane C supplies and accepts another accessible persistent provider for the existing two provider-neutral Boolean semantics; do not redesign those semantics in the packaging lane
dependencies.rationale: PR #33 separated Biology's setting meaning from Mod Settings, but it did not implement another player-accessible persistent provider. Removing Mod Settings now would leave both values at defaults with no accepted attended-test surface for master disable or E3 ON/OFF.

consumerFeatures: transitive dependency of the temporary Mod Settings adapter
dependencies.plannedAction: remove together with Mod Settings unless a separate final Biology feature later proves a direct ArchiveXL requirement
dependencies.rationale: No project-original Biology resource or runtime source consumes ArchiveXL directly. It survives this candidate only because the current accessible Mod Settings adapter requires it.

consumerFeatures: transitive native plumbing for ArchiveXL/Mod Settings
dependencies.plannedAction: remove when the Mod Settings/ArchiveXL chain leaves unless a future concrete Biology-owned native extension proves a separate need
dependencies.rationale: The merged Biology source contains no project-owned RED4ext DLL/plugin consumer. RED4ext survives this candidate only as transitive plumbing for the temporary settings-provider chain.
No merged Biology production source/data path requires TweakXL; REDmod-native tweak source is preferred if future tweak content is needed.
The merged Biology Ink/REDscript source has no Codeware dependency.
Biology defines no current custom input binding that requires Input Loader.
Finished Biology gameplay must be project-owned.
Finished Biology presentation is implemented in Biology-owned source and must not execute Project E3 runtime content.

consumerFeatures: exact-compile base bundle from the installed supported game
dependencies.plannedAction: read/reference only through supported game install; never redistribute
dependencies.rationale: Biology targets the installed game and may not redistribute CDPR executables, archives, scripts, saves, generated stock caches, or final.redscripts.

rules: A dependency without at least one concrete current Biology consumer is not retained.
Retained in the integrated candidate does not mean permanent architecture: Mod Settings, ArchiveXL and RED4ext remain REMOVE/RETHINK routes with an explicit Lane C removal blocker.
The only directly feature-justified supplemental runtime framework in the current merged source is redscript.
A future lane requesting a new dependency must identify the exact feature, why vanilla/REDmod/current redscript cannot satisfy it, and the package/install consequence before this graph changes.
Bundled third-party components require pinned version/hash/license/provenance and exact per-file ownership.
No source gameplay/presentation mod may execute or be bundled.
